controls.title: COSO Principle 1: Integrity and Ethical Values
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Documented code of conduct, ethics training for all employees, background check policy

controls.title: COSO Principle 2: Board Independence and Oversight
controls.description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Board or oversight body with defined security responsibilities

controls.title: COSO Principle 3: Management Structure and Authority
controls.description: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Clear organizational structure with defined security responsibilities

controls.title: COSO Principle 4: Commitment to Competence
controls.description: The entity demonstrates commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Security training program, competency requirements for security roles

controls.title: COSO Principle 5: Accountability
controls.description: The entity holds individuals accountable for internal control responsibilities.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Security responsibilities in job descriptions, accountability mechanisms

controls.title: Information for Internal Control
controls.description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Asset inventory maintained, data classification scheme implemented

controls.title: Internal Communication
controls.description: The entity internally communicates information necessary for internal control.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Security policies communicated to all employees, security awareness program

controls.title: External Communication
controls.description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Privacy policy published, incident notification procedures documented

controls.title: Risk Assessment Objectives
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification of risks.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Annual risk assessment conducted, risk register maintained

controls.title: Risk Identification and Analysis
controls.description: The entity identifies risks and analyzes them to determine how risks should be managed.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Risks identified, assessed for likelihood and impact, treatment decisions documented

controls.title: Fraud Risk Assessment
controls.description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Fraud risks identified and mitigating controls in place

controls.title: Change Risk Assessment
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly affect internal control.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Changes assessed for security impact before implementation

controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.description: The entity selects, develops, and performs evaluations to ascertain whether controls are present and functioning.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Ongoing monitoring of security controls, periodic assessment of control effectiveness

controls.title: Deficiency Communication
controls.description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Deficiencies tracked, remediated, and reported to appropriate levels

controls.title: Control Activities for Mitigation
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to risk mitigation.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Defense-in-depth controls deployed, control effectiveness measured

controls.title: Technology General Controls
controls.description: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Technology controls defined and consistently applied

controls.title: Control Activity Policies
controls.description: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Policies documented, approved, communicated, and reviewed annually

controls.title: Logical Access Security
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security over protected information assets.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Centralized identity provider with RBAC and MFA enforced for all users

controls.title: User Registration and Authorization
controls.description: Prior to issuing access, the entity registers and authorizes new users.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Formal access request and approval process, management authorization required

controls.title: Role-Based Access and Least Privilege
controls.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access based on roles and least privilege.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Roles defined with minimum necessary permissions, periodic access reviews

controls.title: Physical Access Restrictions
controls.description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Physical access controls for data centers and offices, visitor management

controls.title: Deprovisioning Access
controls.description: The entity discontinues logical and physical access when no longer needed.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Access removed within 24 hours of termination, offboarding checklist followed

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from external sources.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Firewall rules, WAF deployed, network segmentation, intrusion detection

controls.title: Data Transmission Security
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission of information to authorized external parties.
controls.evaluation_criteria: TLS 1.2+ enforced, data encryption in transit, DLP controls

controls.title: Software Installation Controls
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious software.
controls.evaluation_criteria: EDR/AV deployed on all endpoints, unauthorized software installation prevented

controls.title: Detection of Security Events
controls.description: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify anomalies and security events.
controls.evaluation_criteria: SIEM/monitoring deployed, security alerting configured, 24/7 monitoring or on-call

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: The entity monitors for and responds to security incidents.
controls.evaluation_criteria: IRP documented and tested, incidents tracked and resolved, lessons learned

controls.title: Incident Recovery
controls.description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from security incidents.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Recovery procedures documented, backups tested, DR plan validated

controls.title: Security Event Communication
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by communicating to affected parties.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Incident notification procedures documented, stakeholders identified

controls.title: Change Management Process
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Changes tracked, reviewed, approved, and tested before production deployment

controls.title: Risk Mitigation Activities
controls.description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Risks treated with appropriate controls, third-party risks assessed

controls.title: Vendor Risk Management
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Critical vendors assessed annually, security requirements in contracts

controls.title: System Availability Commitments
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and usage.
controls.evaluation_criteria: SLAs defined, uptime monitored, capacity planning conducted

controls.title: Environmental Protections
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, and implements environmental protections and controls.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Backups configured and tested, DR plan documented and tested annually

controls.title: Recovery Testing
controls.description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Annual DR test conducted, recovery objectives validated

controls.title: Confidential Information Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Data classified, confidential data identified, handling procedures defined

controls.title: Confidential Information Disposal
controls.description: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet objectives.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Secure disposal procedures for confidential data, records maintained

controls.title: Processing Integrity Objectives
controls.description: The entity obtains or generates, uses, and communicates relevant information regarding processing objectives.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Processing objectives defined, data quality controls implemented

controls.title: System Inputs
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Input validation implemented, error handling defined

controls.title: System Processing
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Processing controls ensure completeness and accuracy

controls.title: System Outputs
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system output activities.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Outputs verified for completeness and distributed to authorized recipients

controls.title: Error Correction
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures to identify and correct processing errors.
controls.evaluation_criteria: Error detection and correction processes defined and operational
